outline.title: Intelligent Workforce Management & Immutable Audit for the Modern Enterprise
outline.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS platform featuring automated compliance, cryptographic ledger, and AI governance.

outline.title: Modern labor complexity demands incorruptible, multi-tenant systems
outline.summary: Organizations face stringent regulations, unpredictable labor audits, complex collective agreement management, and the risk of payroll tampering.

outline.title: AION Workforce combines shift automation with bank-grade cryptographic security
outline.summary: We unify shift management, payroll, collective agreements, absences, and incidents under a deterministic engine protected by an SHA-256 immutable ledger.

outline.title: Strict tenant data isolation and seamless traceability
outline.summary: Each organization operates within a rigorously isolated database space with role-based access control and AI governance.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/5ldHJ922fdVM.png - Architecture and data flow diagram fits the multi-tenant architecture and security slide.

outline.title: Every operational event generates a verifiable cryptographic chain in real time
outline.summary: No shift record or payroll entry can be retroactively altered, with a public chain verification endpoint guaranteeing 100% integrity.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/DQLWuunEIM0O.png - Security data pipeline architecture fits the cryptographic audit chain and immutable ledger slide.

outline.title: Advanced salary automation tailored to complex labor agreements
outline.summary: The payroll engine calculates regular hours, overtime, night shifts, and holidays based on versioned rules from each collective agreement.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/search_images/nF4O0JDbKtJE.webp - Dashboard/analytics graphic fits the enterprise modules and salary automation slide.

outline.title: Scalable architecture with plans tailored to every enterprise stage
outline.summary: From Free plans for early teams to Pro and Enterprise tiers featuring unlimited capacity and integrated Stripe billing.

outline.title: Transform your workforce management today
outline.summary: Request a personalized demo, test the live multi-tenant environment, and discover how AION Workforce eliminates regulatory risk.
